title: Mapping Errors with map_err
goal: Transform error types manually when From is not implemented.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

hints: ParseIntError does not convert to AppError automatically.
Use map_err to convert ParseIntError into AppError before using the try operator.
explanation: Because `AppError` does not implement `From<ParseIntError>`, the `?` operator cannot convert the error automatically (`E0277`). Using `.map_err()` converts `ParseIntError` into `AppError::InvalidNumber` before `?` propagates it.
